value.rationale: This is a natural complete invariant: for each finite field and higher Heisenberg Lie algebra, all ranks and multiplicities of idempotent derivations are determined. The characteristic-two exceptional projections are parametrized by nondegenerate symplectic subspaces, in contrast with the Lagrangian-splitting main branch. The rare-branch probability and its two reflected discrete-Gaussian rank laws expose a structural characteristic transition across infinitely many dimensions, not a renaming or unmotivated single-size count. Counting lemmas are classical, but their coupled derivation constraints are nontrivial and motivate the precise invariant.
